note: Placeholder tables (parity C1/C2/C5/C8). Species are the 16 creatures that have art; Story Bot/Gary own the final pools. Levels follow the CRITICAL_PATH order (route1 before coin 1, thornwood before coin 2, greystone before coin 4, mirefen at coin 5). Structural reference only: no names, numbers or text from any other game. | GENERATED wired table: encounters.json + staged encounters_overnight.json + Game dev overnight_gd species that have sprites. Levels/weights stay PLACEHOLDER.

roll.per: step onto an encounter cell (layer code 1 grass / 2 cave) or a zone rect
roll.pick: weighted by slot.weight among slots whose conditions match; level uniform in [lo, hi]
roll.forced: zone rects with forced:true are the critical-path chokepoints (forced_grass)

variant_roll.hook: encounters.variant_roll(zone, slot, context) -> variant id or null
variant_roll.called: after the species + level are picked, before the battle starts
variant_roll.default: null -> normal; World supplies no odds

conditions.time: optional list of phases (dawn/day/dusk/night, time_of_day/grades.json schedule); slot only rolls in those phases
conditions.weather: optional list (clear/storm); storm = storm_season set (route1 loads route1_storm)
conditions.flood: true = only on flooded variants / floodwater cells

slots.note: storm variant only: floodwater washes river creatures into the grass
